label: Time block
intent: A block of time is drawn on the day: the event block is pulled down from its start hour to its end hour. Light: the block starts as a thin slab at the start hour, and its bottom edge is dragged down in one move and stops dead on the end hour. Strong: the edge is dragged in two snaps, stopping dead on the middle hour first, then on the end hour, and the calendar takes the last snap with a small thump. The hour marks and the leaf stay put.

calendar.//: the whole calendar takes the last snap in Strong

block.//: the block stretches down from its start hour; its top edge never moves
